what: an r7 vertical round at a corner, then r3 along a top edge, which runs on round the r7 arc to the other top edge
method: the r7 vertical round removes (1-pi/4) 7^2 20; the r3 chain runs along x = 60 (y 0..33) and y = 40 (x 0..53), straight, removing (1-pi/4) 3^2 each mm, and round the r7 arc's top edge as a torus quarter: Pappus, the section (1-pi/4) 3^2 with its centroid 3 (10-3pi)/(12-3pi) in from the wall, at radius 7 - that, over pi/2 (as 003).
